_source.frame: Portal-blocking law: the closed set of magics that hold a portal or gate shut. Full spell mechanics for the two Acheron spells live in law:planar-spell:* (M6); rows here are the governing doctrine. Mimir's portal pour (In the Cage) already witnesses the Sigil half.

rows.rule: Sigil's portals come in three forms — permanent, temporary, shifting (plus the Hive's one-way ooze portals) — and all answer to the Lady: portals too disruptive to the city's life inevitably disappear, and only the Lady opens new portals in Sigil. A hidden portal is not a closed one: nothing short of strong magic — planar wards or surelock — holds a portal shut.

Named in the Sigil portal law as one of the two magics that hold a portal closed. Mechanics are printed in Well of Worlds (TSR 2602) — outside the currently distilled corpus; this row is a pointer, not a spell writeup.
rows.gap: Well of Worlds not yet distilled under build/ — mechanics unpoured. When it lands, mint law:planar-spell:planar-ward and link here.

rows.rule: The stronger of Sigil's two portal-sealing magics (Acheron's gate ward is described as a lesser version of it). Named in both witnesses; its own spell text is not in the currently distilled corpus.
rows.gap: surelock's spell block is unpoured (printed in earlier PLANESCAPE material); this row records the doctrine only. Mint law:planar-spell:surelock when its text is distilled.

rows.rule: Acheron's lesser seal (wizard Abjuration 2, reversible): temporarily shuts any one gate between the cubes for 1 round/level, displaying the caster's seal (or face) on the sealed gate; timed right it bounces a creature entering the gate straight back out. Anonymous versions are rumored, unverified. Full block: law:planar-spell:gate-ward.

Acheron's greater seal (wizard Abjuration 3, reversible): as gate ward but 1 turn/level — and cast over a battlefield it makes all cubehopper spells fail within the battle area. Acheron doctrine: generals seal gates to prevent desertion; these spells are widespread there and little known elsewhere. Full block: law:planar-spell:gate-seal.
